description: NaBH₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaBH₄ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.57 Å. B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four H atoms. There are a spread of B-H bond distances ranging from 1.22-1.24 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom.
